rust_summary: several of a mod's audio sources queued together as one multichannel sound, and a source's queue emptied (`native_push_voices`, `native_clear_voices`).
doc_summary: `native_push_voices(mod_id, sources, channels, sample_rate, at)` (client, `host.push_voices`) queues one mono block per source under one lock, all or none, so the channels of a multichannel sound (a video's 5.1 speakers) start in the same output buffer and are never refused one at a time; `native_clear_voices(mod_id, sources)` (`host.clear_voices`) drops what those sources have waiting, after a seek. The limits are `native_push_voice`'s. Bundles need "hooks": @API:push_voices@.
